id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|150f: "Hmm, I see. Then come back healthy. Otherwise the horses will get lonely.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|151c: "Phew. When {var:1} is gone, the horses look lonely.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1527: "Today is this one's day off. Even horses get worn out if they work nonstop.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1534: "They said I could sleep here today, but I can't relax away from the stable. A bed without the smell of hay won't do.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1546: "Finally the village is back to normal. The horses seem happy too.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|154f: "Finally the village is back to normal. The horses seem happy too.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|155a: "Saving the world, {var:1}, you're amazing. When I grow up, I might marry you, you know?
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1566: "...I thought that, but sorry! I'll pass. Big sister Gemma is scary when she's angry.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1572: "Aww, too bad. But {var:1} has big sister Gemma, so it can't be helped.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15e0: "The building's a mess, but some goods survived, so buy what you need.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|673d: "The building's a mess, but some goods survived, so buy what you need.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15f0: "Thanks to Derk's connections, we can get stock steadily now. Buy whatever you need.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|674d: "Thanks to Derk's connections, we can get stock steadily now. Buy whatever you need.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15ff: "Derk is amazing. As expected of someone with a big shop in the castle town. There's nothing left for me to do.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|675c: "Derk is amazing. As expected of someone with a big shop in the castle town. There's nothing left for me to do.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|160f: "Hey, what do you think you're doing! Thanks to you, the monsters are gone and no battle gear sells at all!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|676c: "Hey, what do you think you're doing! Thanks to you, the monsters are gone and no battle gear sells at all!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|161b: "...Just kidding! Ha ha, a joke. In peacetime I'll sell peacetime goods. Peace comes first.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6778: "...Just kidding! Ha ha, a joke. In peacetime I'll sell peacetime goods. Peace comes first.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16a1: "Amber's place has no menfolk. I'd better clear this quick and help at Amber's.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16ad: "I can finally rest the horses that worked nonstop for the village's rebuilding. Maybe I'll feed them good carrots now and then.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16c1: "Nice weather today, too. On a day like this, nothing beats riding a horse across the monster-free plains.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16d3: "Nice weather today, too. On a day like this, ride a horse with Gemma across the plains together.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16e0: "Gemma loves horses too, so she'll be happy.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|179e: "That not a single villager was lost and we all returned is God's will. You should pray too, {var:1}.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17b0: "{var:1}, the Luminary's mission may weigh on you at times. Why not pray to God and find peace?
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17c3: "Pray too, {var:1}, to thank God that the village is restored and everyone has returned to their lives.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17df: "Oh, {var:1}. I was thanking the Earth Spirit for your safe return.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17ea: "Even as the hero who saved the world, you are a Cobblestone man. Never neglect your prayers to the Earth Spirit.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1808: "Even as the hero who saved the world, you are a Cobblestone man. Never neglect your prayers to the Earth Spirit.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17fd: "We can live thanks to the spirits who bring blessings to the land of Erdrea.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|185a: "Rebuilding the village is hard work, but I'm not done yet. Don't you worry about a thing.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|186a: "Be unsightly if you must. Survive whatever happens. And come back to this village.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1879: "You finally fulfilled the Luminary's mission. I'm not surprised. I always believed you'd do it.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1898: "You finally fulfilled the Luminary's mission. I'm not surprised. I always believed you'd do it.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1885: "You worked hard enough for the world. From now on, put your own happiness first.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18a4: "You worked hard enough for the world. From now on, put your family's happiness for Gemma's sake first.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|190f: "When we were about to lose heart, Amber encouraged us, saying it was too early to give up.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|191a: "Amber is truly brave. You two, mother and son, are just alike.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1928: "Cole, listen well. You're the oldest boy among the children at the bastion.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1933: "So you mustn't cry. Stay close and protect them so these kids don't get anxious.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1943: "The Earth Spirit surely sent {var:1} back to us to prepare for this battle.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|194d: "We Cobblestone folk are with the Earth Spirit. Ahh, thank you, thank you.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1959: "Your mother Amber was applying this with us until a moment ago. Where did she go...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1968: "Before you're a Luminary, you're Amber's only son.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1982: "Before you're a Luminary, you're Amber's only son.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|199b: "Before you're a Luminary, you're Amber's only son.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19b5: "Before you're a Luminary, you're Amber's only son.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19cc: "Before you're a Luminary, you're Amber's only son.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1970: "Don't leave your mother alone. Defeat the monster that makes the eternal dark and return to the bastion safely.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|198a: "Don't leave your mother alone. Defeat the monster that makes the eternal dark and return to the bastion safely.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19a3: "Don't leave your mother alone. Defeat the monster that makes the eternal dark and return to the bastion safely.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19be: "Nothing is more unfilial than leaving your mother alone. Make sure you return to this village.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19d5: "Nothing is more unfilial than leaving your mother alone. Make sure you return to this village.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19e2: "Many Heliodor soldiers came and burned the village. I've never been so scared in all my life.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19f0: "Ow, ow, ow... I overdid it in the daytime. My back hurts terribly.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19fb: "Oh, you're back. Well, that's fine. Take it slow. Don't overdo it.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a0d: "A young man like you saving the world. In every age, it's the young, not us old folk, who move the world.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a1c: "The future you young ones build will surely be wonderful. I want to live as long as I can and see it.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ac9: "...{var:1}, you're back! You really are a strong man!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ad1: "The great tree of life fell and the whole continent is in chaos. Yet you came back safe, as expected of Chalky's grandson!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ae0: "Everyone in the village is beyond this gate. Hurry and show your healthy face to encourage them!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1afd: "Everyone in the village is beyond this gate. Hurry and show your healthy face to encourage them!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1af0: "You really are a strong man! Coming back safe amid this chaos, as expected of Chalky's grandson!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b0c: "You really are a strong man! Coming back safe amid this chaos, as expected of Chalky's grandson!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b1c: "The hero's coming back, so everyone went to the entrance to welcome him. If I weren't a gatekeeper, I'd go too.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b2f: "{var:1}, you should pray before the battle. The priest is in the tent south of the village.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b3e: "{var:1}! You did great! The bastion is unscathed! Everyone's safe!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b51: "The King of Heliodor is unlucky, though. Long ago he lost his beloved princess, and now he's even lost his own country.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b5e: "Of the two generals who supported the king, Lord Jasper is missing too. It's as if a bad curse is on him.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b70: "Hey, {var:1}. Cobblestone is in the middle of rebuilding and everyone's working hard.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b7a: "Have you greeted Amber yet? If not, go where your house was. She should be there.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b8f: "No, I'm not playing around. If I do well, tonight's dinner gets one more dish. It's a big responsibility.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b9e: "We probably won't be attacked by Heliodor again, but we still have to keep watch properly.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1be7: "I was surprised when Heliodor's princess came to see you the other day.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bf0: "Not long ago you were a regular country boy, now you know important people from around the world. You've come up.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ccb: "Phew, glad they didn't break the roof. The church roof is high, right? Climbing up to fix it is hard.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cdc: "Fixing the door is top priority. Even with a roof, drafts will give the kids colds.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cef: "You've grown so fine. You've come back from your journey stronger. You're a full adult now.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d09: "You've grown so fine. You've come back from your journey stronger. You're a full adult now.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cfa: "I wish I could show Chalky. Well, it'll make a nice story when my time comes.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d14: "I wish I could show Chalky. Well, it'll make a nice story when my time comes.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d24: "You always clung to Chalky and never left his side. To think you've grown into such a strong man...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d42: "You always clung to Chalky and never left his side. To think you've grown into such a strong man...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d2f: "If Chalky were alive, he'd surely cry for joy seeing you grown up.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d57: "If Chalky were alive, he'd surely cry for joy seeing you grown up.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d4d: "And you're starting a family with Gemma, Cobblestone's idol. Splendid, there's no other word.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2305: "Aww. I'm bored of helping. It's so dark and cold, I can't even play in the water. So boring.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2313: "Mom and the chief and everyone have scary faces... I'm scared... sniff, sniff.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|231e: "I held back from crying and was a very good girl. I'm great, right? Ahem!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|232f: "The sun came back, so I can play in the water again! Hee hee! Water play is so fun!!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|233c: "Dad said clearing big rubble is dangerous so I should play in the river. I want to help too.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|234d: "Today I was told to sleep with everyone at the priest's. I feel kind of restless...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2364: "Yay♪ yay♪ With no monsters I can play outside all I want! Thanks to you, big brother!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23ac: "Grandpa scolded me, saying I'm in the way and don't need to help.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23b6: "Grandma told me not to trouble the priest, so I'm staying quiet here.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23cd: "Big brother, you traveled all over the world, right! Amazing! Tell me what the world was like!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23d8: "Oh, wait! Never mind, don't answer! Someday I'll go on an adventure like you and see it myself!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|242b: "If you gather lots of people on one job it gets inefficient, so we split up the work.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2438: "And he got tonight's dinner-fishing job. I'm just helping him.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2446: "Hmm... we can't preserve caught fish yet. Can't be helped, we'll have to eat them all before they go bad.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2456: "With normal life returning, it feels a little lacking. Like there's not enough excitement...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2465: "With normal life returning, it feels a little lacking. Like there's not enough excitement...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2470: "You're marrying Gemma... How nice. I want to marry soon too. My boyfriend is so indecisive.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2488: "{var:1}, you were a prince of a faraway country. No wonder you have such a dignified face.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2491: "Where and how you live from now is up to {var:1}, but come back here if things get hard.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|249c: "This village is your birthplace, so everyone will always welcome you.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|250e: "What are we applying? If I had to say... hope, I guess.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2516: "Gah! Forget that! It was way too corny! How embarrassing!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2521: "On top of the bastion soldiers and village men, we've got Lord Hendrik, and above all, {var:1}!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|252c: "Even if monsters attack, we won't let them lay a finger on this bastion! Right, {var:1}?
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|253a: "The King of Heliodor is looking for you. You're tired from battle, so what could he want...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|254b: "Children of the great tree... A quiet, quiet night has come.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2552: "Until the child of light awakens, banishes the dark, and a bright tomorrow comes...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2561: "A Heliodor soldier came to call you earlier.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2577: "A Heliodor soldier came to call you earlier.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2567: "The King of Heliodor says it's an errand only you can do, so hurry along.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|257d: "The King of Heliodor says it's an errand only you can do, so hurry along.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|258d: "{var:1}, the Luminary who saved us, is Cobblestone's biggest star! Write me an autograph sometime?
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2598: "Gah! That was a bit improper! Just kidding, don't mind it!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25a6: "Mischievous {var:1} became the Luminary who saves the world. I never imagined it.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25ba: "Mischievous {var:1} became the Luminary who saves the world. I never imagined it.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25b0: "Chalky in heaven must be overjoyed too.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25c4: "Chalky in heaven must be overjoyed too.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25cf: "True, the village burned down, but we're all alive. We can start over as many times as we like.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25da: "The people of this village where you grew up are all stubborn and don't give up. They'll never bow.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25e8: "I'm so glad the village is rebuilt. I worked more than a lifetime, but seeing it now blows my fatigue away.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25fc: "I'm so glad the village is rebuilt. I worked more than a lifetime, but seeing it now blows my fatigue away.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2611: "I hear the chief got a reward from the King of Heliodor as the representative of the village that raised the Luminary.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|261e: "...What, you haven't heard? He must be hogging the reward! Honestly, the chief is so improper!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2650: "That lightning earlier was something. Are you all right? You seem to have gone through a lot...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26a5: "Some places are still smoldering. Soot gets on the laundry, what a nuisance.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26b1: "This village is your hometown, right? Never forget that. Because it'd be sad if you forgot...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26c0: "This village is your hometown, right? Never forget that. Because it'd be sad if you forgot...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26d1: "I climbed the Sacred Rock after a long time. The great tree of life shone in the sunlight as always.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26de: "The great tree has been there since long before we were born. It will watch over us forever, won't it.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|276a: "Good thing the horses are safe. While we were apart, I kept worrying how they were.

tm.「ふ～ん そっか。\n それじゃあ 元気に帰ってきてよね。\n でないと おウマ: "Hmm, I see. Then come back healthy. Otherwise the horses will get lonely.
tm.「よかった～。\n {var:1}が いないと\n おウマさんたちが さびしそう: "Phew. When {var:1} is gone, the horses look lonely.
tm.「今日は この子が お休みの日なの。\n ウマだって はたらきっぱなしだと\n: "Today is this one's day off. Even horses get worn out if they work nonstop.
tm.「今日は ここで寝ていいって 言われたけど\n ウマ小屋の近くじゃないと 落ち着: "They said I could sleep here today, but I can't relax away from the stable. A bed without the smell of hay won't do.
tm.「やっと 村も元通りね。\n ウマたちも よろこんでるみたい。: "Finally the village is back to normal. The horses seem happy too.
tm.「世界を救うなんて {var:1} すごいわね。\n あたしが 大人になったら\: "Saving the world, {var:1}, you're amazing. When I grow up, I might marry you, you know?
tm.「……と思ったけど ごめん！\n やっぱり やめておくわ。\n エマねえちゃんを: "...I thought that, but sorry! I'll pass. Big sister Gemma is scary when she's angry.
tm.「ええ～ それは残念。\n でも {var:1}には\n エマねえちゃんがいるか: "Aww, too bad. But {var:1} has big sister Gemma, so it can't be helped.
tm.「建物は こんなザマなんだけどね\n いくつか 無事だった商品があるから\n 必: "The building's a mess, but some goods survived, so buy what you need.
tm.「デクさんのツテのおかげで 商品を安定して\n 仕入れられるように なったんだよ: "Thanks to Derk's connections, we can get stock steadily now. Buy whatever you need.
tm.「デクさんは すごいわね。さすがは城下町で\n 大きなお店を かまえているだけは: "Derk is amazing. As expected of someone with a big shop in the castle town. There's nothing left for me to do.
tm.「ちょっと どうしてくれるんだい！\n あんたのせいで 魔物がいなくなって\n: "Hey, what do you think you're doing! Thanks to you, the monsters are gone and no battle gear sells at all!
tm.「……な～んてね。あははっ 冗談だよ。\n 平和な時代には それに合った道具を売: "...Just kidding! Ha ha, a joke. In peacetime I'll sell peacetime goods. Peace comes first.
tm.「ペルラさんとこは 男手がねーからな。\n こっちを さっさと片付けて\n ぺル: "Amber's place has no menfolk. I'd better clear this quick and help at Amber's.
tm.「村の復興のため はたらきづめだった\n ウマたちを ようやく 休ませてやれるべ: "I can finally rest the horses that worked nonstop for the village's rebuilding. Maybe I'll feed them good carrots now and then.
tm.「今日も いい天気だべ。\n こんな日は ウマに乗って\n 魔物がいない大草原を: "Nice weather today, too. On a day like this, nothing beats riding a horse across the monster-free plains.
tm.「今日も いい天気だべ。\n こんな日は エマちゃんと一緒に ウマに乗って\n: "Nice weather today, too. On a day like this, ride a horse with Gemma across the plains together.
tm.「エマちゃんも ウマ好きだから\n きっと よろこぶべ。: "Gemma loves horses too, so she'll be happy.
tm.「村の者が ひとりも欠けることなく\n 戻ってこられたのも すべては 神の思し召: "That not a single villager was lost and we all returned is God's will. You should pray too, {var:1}.
tm.「{var:1}よ。時には 勇者の使命が\n その心身に重く のしかかることもあ: "{var:1}, the Luminary's mission may weigh on you at times. Why not pray to God and find peace?
tm.「村が元通りになり みんなが自分の生活に\n 戻れたことを 神に感謝するため\n: "Pray too, {var:1}, to thank God that the village is restored and everyone has returned to their lives.
tm.「おおっ {var:1}か。\n お前が 無事に帰ってきたことを\n 大地の精霊: "Oh, {var:1}. I was thanking the Earth Spirit for your safe return.
tm.「世界を救った英雄とはいえ お前も イシの民。\n いかなる時も 大地の精霊への: "Even as the hero who saved the world, you are a Cobblestone man. Never neglect your prayers to the Earth Spirit.
tm.「我らが 生きていけるのは\n ロトゼタシアの大地に 恵みをもたらす\n 精霊た: "We can live thanks to the spirits who bring blessings to the land of Erdrea.
